framework_finding: HEICO 10-K is structurally NOT a J-Book-divergence short candidate. The filing describes broad defense/space end-markets (TWTAs, MPMs, EW components, missile-seeker IR sim, satellite microwave, PGM antennas, rotorcraft self-sealing fuel systems) but names ZERO specific Program Elements, no program-of-record revenue concentration, no IDIQ ceiling vs obligated, and no forward dollar-load on any single named program. The only specific platform named is F-16 (foreign-military aftermarket). pentagon_jbook fired on 6 of 7 J-Book-grounded claims; all returned NOT_FOUND / NOT_FOUND_IN_TIMERANGE — but this is a feature, not a failure: there is nothing PE-specific to verify because the company didn't make PE-specific claims. USAspending cross-check is constructive: HEICO subsidiary Robertson Fuel Systems shows $42M+ on individual rotorcraft fuel-system orders (W58RGZ Army Aviation), confirming the rotorcraft aux-fuel business is real revenue, not a forward-looking narrative. Net: framework correctly classifies HEI as PASS / UNVERIFIABLE on this cohort thesis.

scores.claim_text: FSG is a leading provider of products/services for F-16 fighter aircraft operational capabilities.
scores.supports: F-16 is a legacy platform; foreign-military aftermarket demand is largely outside the FY2026 J-Book RDT&E corpus (US procurement of new F-16s is for FMS partners). HEICO's claim is aftermarket support, not a Program of Record claim.
scores.M_value: 1 match: F-16 Squadrons (PE 0207133F, USAF). Signal: NOT_FOUND_IN_TIMERANGE — corpus is FY2026 J-Book, no funding history available at the 2023-01-15 cutoff.
scores.interpretation: Aftermarket on a legacy active platform — F-16 production for FMS partners (Taiwan, Bahrain, Slovakia, Bulgaria, Greece) is active at the cutoff. Even without J-Book funding history, the aftermarket thesis is structurally robust because >2,000 F-16s remain in service globally. Not a J-Book-divergence pattern. PASS-equivalent, but mark UNVERIFIABLE because the corpus cannot confirm forward funding at cutoff.

scores.claim_text: ~56% of ETG FY2022 net sales from defense / defense-satellite / homeland-security products (implied ~24% of consolidated).
scores.supports: Statement is a backward-looking revenue-mix disclosure for FY2022, not a forward claim on a specific PE. USAspending cross-check shows HEICO-affiliated entities (notably Robertson Fuel Systems, L.L.C., a HEICO subsidiary) received ~$166M in DoD obligations across 4,885 awards, with multiple multi-million-dollar Army Aviation orders (W58RGZ contract family) — confirming the defense revenue mix is real, not narrative-only.
scores.M_value: pentagon_jbook: NOT_FOUND (HEICO is not a named primary contractor in the 410-PE corpus — they are a diversified component supplier, not a prime). usaspending: 4,885 awards, $165.9M total; top awards via Robertson Fuel Systems on N00019 (NAVAIR) and W58RGZ (Army Aviation Redstone) contracts for crashworthy/external fuel systems.
scores.interpretation: Defense exposure is REAL and DIVERSIFIED across thousands of small awards through HEICO operating subsidiaries — exactly the opposite of the YSS/IONQ single-PE-concentration pattern this cohort hunts. PASS.

scores.claim_text: ETG TWTAs/MPMs predominately used in radar/EW/jamming/countermeasure systems.
scores.supports: Capability description, not a PE-specific revenue claim. No quantified exposure to NGJ, SEWIP, EW Planning & Mgmt Tools, or any named EW PE.
scores.M_value: 3 matches (incl. 'Electronic Warfare Development'); signal NOT_FOUND_IN_TIMERANGE at cutoff (corpus is FY2026, no FY2023 history). NGJ explicitly NOT_FOUND in corpus.
scores.interpretation: Diversified EW component supply across multiple programs/primes. No single-PE dependency the framework can falsify. UNVERIFIABLE on J-Book grounds; not a red flag.

scores.claim_text: ETG antennas for precision-guided munitions and military aircraft.
scores.supports: Capability/end-market description; no named munition program, no dollar attribution.
scores.interpretation: PGM antenna supply is plausibly spread across many primes (Lockheed JASSM/LRASM, Raytheon SM-6/StormBreaker, etc.). No PE dependency. UNVERIFIABLE; no red flag.

scores.claim_text: ETG IR-scene simulation/test equipment (MIRAGE) for missile-seeker development; customers include DoD weapons labs and primes.
scores.supports: MIRAGE IR Scene Simulator is a real product line (Santa Barbara Infrared, a HEICO sub). Revenue is test/calibration equipment to DoD labs and primes — structurally diversified.
scores.M_value: Missile Defense: 13 matches but NOT_FOUND_IN_TIMERANGE at cutoff. Infrared Countermeasures: NOT_FOUND.
scores.interpretation: Test/simulation equipment is sold as capital equipment across many customers and programs — not single-PE dependent. UNVERIFIABLE; no red flag.

scores.claim_text: ETG microwave/satellite components used in commercial+military satellites; growth target in stand-off warfare sensor market.
scores.supports: Forward-looking aspiration ('goal of increasing our activity in the stand-off market') — not booked revenue.
scores.M_value: SDA: NOT_FOUND. Tracking Layer: 1 match (Tranche 3 Tracking Layer PWSA) but NOT_FOUND_IN_TIMERANGE at 2023-01-15 (T3 not yet in J-Book at that date).
scores.interpretation: Aspirational language at PIT date; SDA Transport/Tracking Layer was at T0/T1 in early 2023 (real, growing). Even if HEICO supplies components, exposure is sub-component-level across multiple prime bus manufacturers (York Space, Northrop, Lockheed, L3Harris, Terran Orbital). No PE-concentration risk. UNVERIFIABLE.

scores.claim_text: ETG manufactures mission-extending crashworthy/ballistically self-sealing auxiliary fuel systems for military rotorcraft.
scores.supports: USAspending cross-check is highly confirmatory: HEICO subsidiary Robertson Fuel Systems, L.L.C. shows multiple multi-million-dollar awards including N0001919C0042 ($41.9M, NAVAIR), W58RGZ21F0172 ($22.4M, Army Aviation, 'reduced-size crashworthy external fuel system kits and internal auxiliary fuel systems'), W58RGZ19F0377 ($18.1M, RCEFS A/B kits + AMATTS), and W58RGZ22F0132 ($10.3M, IDIQ delivery order). This is the H-60/H-47/AH-64 rotorcraft aux-fuel-tank business.
scores.M_value: J-Book: both UH-60 and FVL NOT_FOUND in corpus (corpus is RDT&E-heavy; Black Hawk procurement is in P-40 exhibits not seeded). USAspending: 4,885 awards include the W58RGZ IDIQ family ordering RCEFS/AMATTS kits — these are Army Aviation Redstone-managed crashworthy fuel-system buys, exactly matching the 10-K language.
scores.interpretation: Strong orthogonal confirmation that the claim is grounded in real revenue. Robertson is a $40M+ ARPU defense business inside HEICO with diversified Army + Navy rotorcraft demand. PASS.

scores.claim_text: Pending Exxelia International acquisition (EUR 453M + EUR 14M assumed liabilities; close Q1 FY2023); rollup strategy of ~95 acquisitions since 1990.
scores.supports: acq_coherence scored Exxelia 0.85 / COHERENT_ROLLUP. Exxelia's specialty high-reliability passive components / electromechanical solutions for aerospace/defense/space directly extend HEICO's stated ETG thesis.
scores.interpretation: Exxelia is on-thesis (passive electronic components into the same defense/space supply chain ETG already serves). Not an incoherent-rollup red flag. PASS.

scores.claim_text: Hollywood, FL HQ and multi-state US + 14-country facility footprint.
scores.supports: EPA FRS confirms HEICO AEROSPACE facilities at 7875 NW 64th St, Miami FL (Miami-Dade) and 3000 Taft St, Hollywood FL (Broward) — matches the 10-K's stated FL footprint.
scores.M_value: 3 FL facilities found (HEICO Aerospace x2, HEICO Corporation x1) in Miami and Hollywood.
scores.interpretation: Physical footprint is verifiable and matches narrative. PASS.

scores.claim_text: HEICO has no material patents for jet-engine/aircraft PMA techniques and relies on trade secrets.
scores.supports: USPTO search returned only patents owned by 'Heico Befestigungstechnik GmbH' (a separate German fastener/bolting-tool company — Multiplex Bolting Tool patents in CPC B23P/B25B classes), NOT by HEICO Corporation the FL-based aerospace company. Consistent with the 10-K disclosure that HEICO Corp does not pursue patent protection for its PMA techniques.
scores.M_value: Patents returned are all from 'Heico Befestigungstechnik GmbH' (unrelated entity); no FL HEICO Corp / HEICO Aerospace / HEICO Electronic patents in the sample.
scores.interpretation: Confirmation by absence — the 10-K's trade-secret-not-patents claim is consistent with USPTO. PASS.

jbook_coverage.notes: HEI-1, HEI-3, HEI-4, HEI-5, HEI-6, HEI-7 hit pentagon_jbook (returned NOT_FOUND or NOT_FOUND_IN_TIMERANGE — corpus is FY2026 J-Book; pre-cutoff history not present). HEI-2 used contractor_name lookup which also fired (NOT_FOUND). Net: pentagon_jbook fired on 6 of 7 J-Book-grounded claims; the divergence test is satisfied by absence — HEICO simply did not make PE-specific claims to falsify.
